billingCategory.title: Billing Category
billingCategory.summary: A structured billing classification for time entries
billingCategory.description: Represents a controlled billing classification (billable, non-billable or internal) for time entries, with Dutch compliance flags for WBSO (R&D tax credit) and Wet DBA (ZZP contractor) reporting. Mapped to Schema.org DefinedTerm.

name.description: Display name of the category (e.g. 'Declarabel', 'WBSO O&O')
name.title: Name

code.description: Short machine-readable identifier, unique across categories (e.g. 'BILL', 'WBSO', 'DBA')
code.title: Code

type.description: Classification type used for reporting and aggregation
type.title: Type

color.description: Hex colour code used for UI badges and chart segments (e.g. '#28a745')
color.title: Colour

description.description: Explanation of when this category should be applied

isDefault.description: Whether this category is pre-selected on new time entries (at most one active default)
isDefault.title: Default

requiresWbsoRef.description: When true, time entries in this category must carry a WBSO project reference
requiresWbsoRef.title: Requires WBSO reference

isDba.description: When true, marks hours as ZZP/DBA contractor work for Wet DBA tax compliance
isDba.title: DBA contractor

isActive.description: Whether the category is available for selection on new time entries
isActive.title: Active

objects.name: Declarabel
objects.description: Uren die rechtstreeks aan de klant worden gefactureerd op basis van het afgesproken uurtarief of vaste prijs.

objects.name: Niet-declarabel
objects.description: Uren die intern worden gedragen en niet aan de klant worden doorbelast. Bijvoorbeeld: offertebegeleiding, interne overleggen, garantiewerk.

objects.name: Intern
objects.description: Interne overhead-uren: teamvergaderingen, administratie, opleidingen, verlof en ziekteverlof.

objects.name: WBSO O&O
objects.description: Speur- en ontwikkelingswerk (S&O) dat kwalificeert voor WBSO-tegemoetkoming via de RVO. Vereist een WBSO-projectreferentie op de tijdregel.

objects.name: DBA Opdracht
objects.description: Uren gewerkt door zelfstandige opdrachtnemers (ZZP) in het kader van de Wet DBA. Wordt apart gerapporteerd voor belastingcompliance.
